怎么学：前置 → 每天一轮 → 复习: How to study: set up → one round a day → review
前置是配模型、填考试日期，之后每学完一章备一次料：导入、出题、检查草稿、发布。练: Setup is choosing a model and entering the exam date; after that, prepare each chapter once you have studied it: import, make questions, check the draft, publish. Practice is one “Study today” round a day: think before you answer, and sort out a mistake right there. You do not schedule review: due questions join the daily round by themselves; once a week, clear your mistakes and look at weak topics; at the end of a unit, take a timed mock exam. The tour follows this order.
记不住入口？找功能: Where was that? Find a feature
按 Ctrl K（或点侧栏「找功能」）输入关键词，选中后直接带你过去。任何页面按: Press Ctrl K (or choose “Find a feature” in the sidebar), type a word, and picking a result takes you straight there. On any page, ? shows that page’s keyboard shortcuts, and S resumes your last round or starts today’s study.
学习库：今天学什么: Study library: what to study today
首页根据到期复习、错题和新题排好今天的计划，点一下就开始。一轮默认最多 20 题: The home page plans today from due reviews, mistakes and new questions, so one click starts you off. A round holds up to 20 questions by default (change it in Settings › Practice), in the order due → weak → new, and new questions take at most half. All your decks are organised by course below.
在原文里提问、出题: Ask and make questions right in the original
出题需要先配置 AI 模型，在哪里设置见前面的「前置」一章。: Making questions needs an AI model; the Setup chapter earlier in the tour shows where to set one up.
抽查 3–5 道，看三件事：答案在引用的原文里找得到依据；考的是知识本身，不是「: Check 3–5 questions for three things: the quoted passage really supports the answer; it tests the knowledge itself, not “what the material said”; and only one answer is right. Code checks quotes and structure, but the content can still be wrong. “Publish and practise” asks no model to review again: a question with a structural problem is published too, and shows “Needs check” while you practise.
AI 出的题先放进草稿。你可以逐题核对、修改或删除，确认无误再发布，发布后就能开: New questions land in a draft first. Check, edit or delete each one, then publish when you are happy and start practising. Saving and publishing are in this bar at the foot of the page. This is a sample draft.
选择题会逐项说明对在哪、错在哪；闪卡先回忆再翻面自评。每次作答后，系统按记忆曲线: Multiple-choice questions explain why each option is right or wrong; flashcards ask you to recall, flip and rate yourself. After each answer, the next review is scheduled on a forgetting curve. Below the question are three helpers: “Help me understand” puts an explanation under this question, “Improve question” edits this card directly, and “Generate a prerequisite question…” under “More” adds an easier question. Try answering one.
想完再按 Space 翻面，按 0–5 自评。0、1 是想不起来，本轮末尾重练；: Think first, then press Space to flip, and rate yourself 0–5. 0 and 1 mean you could not recall it, and it comes back at the end of this round; 2 means your answer was incomplete; 3, you recalled it with effort; 4, you answered smoothly; 5, you could teach it. A 5 counts the question as “Mastered” at once, so do not tap it lightly. Z undoes a wrong press.
做完一轮，先看本轮题目: After a round, look at its questions first
结算页的「本轮题目」列出这轮错了、没掌握和没答的题：点开回看你的答案、正确答案和: “Questions in this round” on the result page lists what you got wrong, rated as not yet known, or left unanswered. Open one to look back at your answer, the right answer and its Q&A; with mistakes you can “Hide answers and test yourself” or retry them at once. The round is finished only when you can say why you were wrong.
后台助教会结合原文讲解这道题、补上前置知识。讲解会出现在这道题下面的问答里，完成: A background assistant explains the question from the source and fills in what you need to know first. The explanation appears under this question, in its Q&A; the inbox tells you when it is done, so your practice is not interrupted. To reason it out step by step, choose “Guided study” beside it: a question-by-question dialogue opens beside the card. If the question itself looks wrong, choose “Improve question” and the assistant edits this card directly. If the basics are shaky, choose “Generate a prerequisite question…” under “More”, or “Turn into a prerequisite question” under an explanation, to add an easier question to the same deck.

错题与待巩固：举一反三: Mistakes & weak points: learn by analogy
掌握度看的是记得多久: Mastery measures how long you remember
掌握度把每道题按级别折算再取平均，不是正确率：未学、薄弱、学习中（间隔不到 6: Mastery scores each question by its level and averages them; it is not your accuracy. The levels are Not started, Weak, Learning (interval under 6 days), Familiar (6 days or more) and Mastered (right several times in a row with the interval grown past 3 weeks, or rated “Easy” by you). Even if you got everything right just after studying, the number is not high at once: it rises when you get them right again days later.

考前怎么安排: Planning the weeks before an exam
考前约三周起，每天照常做今日学习，每周限时模拟一两套；考前一周主攻错题、顽固题和: From about three weeks before, keep up the daily round and take one or two timed mock exams a week. In the last week, work on mistakes, stubborn questions and the topics that need work. In the last day or two, only review; do not make large batches of new questions. With an exam date in the course settings, reviews are scheduled to fit the exam (“Align reviews with exams” is on by default). Afterwards, set the course to inactive.
